final: WITH per_playlist AS (SELECT PlaylistId, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM PlaylistTrack GROUP BY PlaylistId), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS mean_count FROM per_playlist) SELECT per_playlist.PlaylistId, per_playlist.record_count, per_playlist.record_count * 1.0 / avg_count.mean_count FROM per_playlist CROSS JOIN avg_count ORDER BY per_playlist.record_count * 1.0 / avg_count.mean_count DESC LIMIT 10
